title: LoRa Vehicle Controller: Reconstruction and Platform Redesign
summary: An STM32 and LoRa vehicle-controller project with reconstructed KiCad hardware, annotated schematics, a searchable engineering workspace, assembly evidence and a reproducible V1 firmware build. V2 hardware and a voice/text/location handheld remain under development.

validated_results.claim: Fifteen annotated schematic pages were visually inspected after export.
Presentation edits preserved all baseline components and 533 electrical pins without changing net names, values or footprints.
Two V1 builds on the recorded host and toolchain produced identical ELF, HEX and BIN hashes.
Purchasing and assembly exports reconcile physical references and separate candidate parts from holds and board features.
Viewer desktop/mobile interaction checks and 203 local HTTP links passed at the recorded checkpoint.
Eighteen quality-tool acceptance tests passed; isolated schematic generation preserved PCB, project and BOM artifacts.
Separate V2 Stage A diagnostic builds twice with identical ELF/HEX/BIN; 1328-byte BIN, nine pin-contract tests pass. No hardware operation is claimed.
Localized ground repair reduces V2 unconnected PCB items from three to zero with zero ordinary DRC errors and unchanged warnings/parity; all footprints and pad assignments preserved.

An isolated IMU interface schematic adds a 1.8 V rail and I2C/interrupt translation. Native comparison verifies exactly five changed existing connections, 356 preserved memberships and no new ERC findings; PCB integration remains pending.

current_native_findings.scope_note: Strict gate retains the existing V2 ERC warning and detects the intentional PCB ground correction against the older preservation baseline; six component-limit blockers remain.

roadmap: Assess placement and local routing for the verified IMU interface candidate while retaining the corrected ground network; resolve the five power/signal-limit findings before hardware release.
Extend the implemented Stage A diagnostic after electrical acceptance; freeze the operational protocol and measure supervised-output failsafe behavior.
Complete V2 connector atlas, exact-part qualification, purchasing decisions and recorded board bring-up.
Measure voice quality, airtime and RC coexistence before selecting handheld radio, codec or hardware.
claim_boundaries: No verified range, autonomous navigation, speech quality or voice/RC coexistence result is claimed.
V1 source contains radio, GPS and PWM implementations but retains known safety and parsing defects.
Protocol/failsafe prototypes are review proposals; no functional firmware correction is represented as integrated.
A successful compile does not establish original deployed firmware, hardware operation or safety qualification.
PCB renders are CAD illustrations, not photographs of tested hardware.
Candidate purchasing CSVs are partial review lists, not complete approved orders or fabrication releases.
Handset source is absent; the multifunction handheld is proposed.
Jay's individual original team role must be confirmed before first-person contribution claims.
